warnings.message: Gemini CLI has no model for the `strong` hint, so @examples/code-reviewer uses the session's model; set targets.gemini.overrides.model to choose one.
Gemini CLI's agents can't preload skills, so @examples/code-reviewer's skills are installed but not preloaded; the agent finds them as any other skill.
@examples/format-on-edit's command uses an $RMK_ variable; Gemini CLI passes the event as JSON on stdin instead, so the hook has to read it from there.
Gemini CLI's project policies don't work yet, so @examples/safe-git was skipped; install it with --scope user.
